label: Auction: bid + nominate in-app. Tap Bid on a lot (or Nominate in the ERA pool), set your $K amount, and it submits to MFL on your behalf — then re-reads the board to confirm the new high bid. A one-tap "On MFL ↗" fallback stays on every card. Gated by a commish kill switch (off = falls back to MFL's page). Phase 1 — dry-run before the July FA Auction.
